title: PS5 Homebrew Compendium — Platform
description: Schema for a platform definition file at library/platforms/<id>/platform.json. Lists the item files that belong to the platform. Item objects themselves are validated by item.schema.json.

id.description: Stable machine id. Attached to every item loaded from this platform as `platformId`.

description.description: One-line summary shown when a platform is introduced.

icon.description: Named icon key from the app sprite (e.g. gamepad, unlock, tool, app).

items.description: Filename within this platform's items/ folder. Convention: item id with hyphens replaced by underscores (ps5-retroarch -> ps5_retroarch.json).

itemFiles.description: ORDERED list of item files. Required because static hosts cannot list a directory.
